brief: A meeting scheduler where time flows as a river — free slots are calm water, meetings are bridges

dominant_strengths: Evocative river metaphor with layered blue gradients suggests flowing time and calm free slots in a memorable way
Current-time indicator as a yellow current line is a clever literal translation of the brief's flow concept
Single-column timeline keeps cognitive load low and the wave logo reinforces the thematic identity
dominant_weaknesses: Meetings are rendered as muddy brown pills, not bridges — the central metaphor of the brief is unfulfilled visually
Event chips float arbitrarily at the left edge with no horizontal duration encoding, wasting the wide canvas
Brown-on-blue contrast feels silty rather than harmonious; type sizing is uniform and lacks hierarchy between title and time
fix_priorities: Render meetings as actual bridge shapes spanning the river width with piers at start/end times
Encode duration via horizontal extent and add subtle ripple/eddy textures around bridges
Refine palette: replace muddy browns with warm wood/stone tones that complement the blue water
Introduce typographic hierarchy and a clearer current-time treatment with timestamp label
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral metaphor lands moderately, but behavioral utility is weak because events don't map to time spans, and reflective delight is undercut by the missing bridge motif.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially solves the brief — the river atmosphere is present, but meetings read as generic pills rather than bridges, leaving the core metaphor half-built.
